query_sql.sales: SELECT COUNT(*) SalesOrders,SUM(MerchandiseRevenue) Revenue,SUM(FreightAmount) Freight FROM dw.FactOrders WHERE SalesEligible=1
query_sql.category_sales: SELECT p.CategoryLabel,SUM(i.ItemPrice) Revenue,COUNT(*) ItemRows,COUNT(DISTINCT i.OrderKey) Orders FROM dw.FactOrderItems i JOIN dw.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey=i.ProductKey WHERE i.SalesEligible=1 GROUP BY p.CategoryLabel ORDER BY Revenue DESC,p.CategoryLabel
query_sql.seller_sales: SELECT i.SellerKey,SUM(i.ItemPrice) Revenue,COUNT(*) ItemRows,COUNT(DISTINCT i.OrderKey) Orders FROM dw.FactOrderItems i WHERE i.SalesEligible=1 GROUP BY i.SellerKey ORDER BY Revenue DESC,i.SellerKey
query_sql.approximate_state_sales: SELECT g.ApproximateState,SUM(o.MerchandiseRevenue) Revenue,COUNT(*) Orders FROM dw.FactOrders o JOIN dw.DimCustomer c ON c.CustomerKey=o.CustomerKey JOIN dw.DimGeography g ON g.GeographyKey=c.GeographyKey WHERE o.SalesEligible=1 GROUP BY g.ApproximateState ORDER BY Revenue DESC,g.ApproximateState
query_sql.monthly_sales: SELECT CONVERT(char(7),PurchaseTimestamp,126) Month,SUM(MerchandiseRevenue) Revenue,COUNT(*) Orders FROM dw.FactOrders WHERE SalesEligible=1 GROUP BY CONVERT(char(7),PurchaseTimestamp,126) ORDER BY Month
query_sql.approximate_state_delivery: SELECT g.ApproximateState,COUNT(*) DeliveredOrders,SUM(CONVERT(int,o.OnTimeEligible)) Eligible,SUM(CASE WHEN o.IsOnTime=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OnTimeOrders,SUM(CASE WHEN o.IsOnTime=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) LateOrders,AVG(o.DeliveryDurationDays) AverageDays FROM dw.FactOrders o JOIN dw.DimOrderStatus s ON s.OrderStatusKey=o.OrderStatusKey JOIN dw.DimCustomer c ON c.CustomerKey=o.CustomerKey JOIN dw.DimGeography g ON g.GeographyKey=c.GeographyKey WHERE s.OrderStatus='delivered' GROUP BY g.ApproximateState
query_sql.category_reviews: WITH membership AS (SELECT DISTINCT i.OrderKey,p.CategoryLabel FROM dw.FactOrderItems i JOIN dw.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey=i.ProductKey) SELECT m.CategoryLabel,COUNT(*) ValidReviews,AVG(CONVERT(decimal(20,10),r.ReviewScore)) AverageScore FROM membership m JOIN dw.FactReviews r ON r.OrderKey=m.OrderKey WHERE r.ValidScore=1 GROUP BY m.CategoryLabel ORDER BY ValidReviews DESC,m.CategoryLabel
query_sql.category_delivery: WITH membership AS (SELECT DISTINCT i.OrderKey,p.CategoryLabel FROM dw.FactOrderItems i JOIN dw.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey=i.ProductKey) SELECT m.CategoryLabel,COUNT(*) Eligible,SUM(CASE WHEN o.IsOnTime=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OnTimeOrders FROM membership m JOIN dw.FactOrders o ON o.OrderKey=m.OrderKey WHERE o.OnTimeEligible=1 GROUP BY m.CategoryLabel ORDER BY Eligible DESC,m.CategoryLabel
query_sql.duration_bands: SELECT CASE WHEN DeliveryDurationDays<7 THEN '01 | Under 7 days' WHEN DeliveryDurationDays<14 THEN '02 | 7 to <14 days' WHEN DeliveryDurationDays<21 THEN '03 | 14 to <21 days' WHEN DeliveryDurationDays<30 THEN '04 | 21 to <30 days' ELSE '05 | 30+ days' END Band,COUNT(*) Orders FROM dw.FactOrders WHERE DurationEligible=1 GROUP BY CASE WHEN DeliveryDurationDays<7 THEN '01 | Under 7 days' WHEN DeliveryDurationDays<14 THEN '02 | 7 to <14 days' WHEN DeliveryDurationDays<21 THEN '03 | 14 to <21 days' WHEN DeliveryDurationDays<30 THEN '04 | 21 to <30 days' ELSE '05 | 30+ days' END
